name: GeoBuddy
author: BuddyDevelopers

sections.description:
GeoBuddy is the foundation plugin for every GeoDirectory-powered directory site.

One free plugin gives you a stepwise form, a floating action bar, one-click demo sites, and — for the first time — an AI agent that can manage your directory for you. Everything else clips on as an addon.

At a Glance

  • 🤖 AI Management — Let Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP client read and manage your listings
  • 📋 Multistep Form — Stepwise “Add Listing” form, free, no addon needed
  • 🎯 Floating Action Bar — Sticky call-to-action bar on listing pages
  • 🗂️ One-Click Templates — Full demo sites imported in a few clicks
  • 🧩 Custom Fields — Social profile links + 360° virtual tour
  • 🧱 8+ Addons — Extend forms, messaging, weather, broadcasting & more

🤖 GeoBuddy AI — Run Your Directory With AI

This is the headline feature. GeoBuddy ships an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server built into WordPress’s Abilities API, so AI assistants can talk to your GeoDirectory site directly — no custom code, no Zapier, no manual admin work.

Free, built into GeoBuddy core — read-only:

  • List, get & search GeoDirectory listings
  • Browse categories, tags, custom fields & post types
  • Read GeoDirectory settings, countries & map markers
  • Read general WordPress site info, plugins & options

GeoBuddy AI addon — read/write control:

  • ✏️ Create & update listings
  • ⭐ Manage reviews
  • ⚙️ Manage GeoDirectory settings
  • 🔐 Scoped, auditable actions — nothing is silently deleted

How it connects: AI Client (Claude / ChatGPT / etc.) talks to the MCP Server in GeoBuddy core, which routes to the free Read tools and, if installed, the GeoBuddy AI addon’s Write tools — both acting on your GeoDirectory site.

GeoBuddy AI addon

Core Features (Free)

📋 Multistep Form — Breaks the GeoDirectory “Add Listing” form into clean steps with a progress indicator, works out of the box. Custom labels & progress bar styles are in the Multistep Form addon.

🎯 Floating Action Bar — Sticky bottom bar on listing detail pages with Call, WhatsApp, Share & Favorite (4 items, free). Unlimited items & full builder controls are in the Floating Action Bar addon.

🗂️ Site Templates — One-click importer for full GeoDirectory demo sites: theme, plugins, pages, categories, listings & menus in one guided flow. Additive (safe) or Full Reset (replaces everything) modes. Free templates are open to everyone; paid templates need a GeoBuddy Bundle license.

🧩 Custom Fields — Adds a few extra listing fields: social links (YouTube, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, TikTok) and a 360° virtual tour embed.

Addons

  • 🤖 GeoBuddy AI — full read/write AI management of your site
  • 📋 Multistep Form — custom step labels, progress bar styles & positions
  • 🎯 Floating Action Bar — unlimited action items + full builder controls
  • 💬 Private Message — direct messaging between users & listing owners
  • 🎉 Confetti — celebration animation on listing submission
  • 📢 Announcement Bar — site-wide announcement banner
  • ⛅ Weather Forecast — real-time weather on listing pages
  • 📡 Broadcasting — broadcast messages to users or listing owners

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.5+ (6.9+ for the AI/MCP server)
  • PHP 7.4+
  • GeoDirectory plugin (required)

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
See: http://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the geobuddy folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate GeoBuddy
  3. Make sure GeoDirectory is installed and activated
  4. Configure everything from the GeoBuddy settings panel
sections.faq:
Does GeoBuddy work without GeoDirectory?

No, GeoDirectory is required.

What does GeoBuddy AI actually do?

It exposes your GeoDirectory data through an MCP server so AI assistants can query it. Core GeoBuddy is read-only and free; the GeoBuddy AI addon unlocks write access (create/update listings, manage reviews & settings).

Do I need a license for templates?

Free templates are open to everyone. Paid templates require a GeoBuddy Bundle Membership license, entered in the Templates tab.

Will importing a template overwrite my site?

Only in Full Reset mode. Additive mode (default) adds content alongside what you already have. Full Reset cannot be undone — back up first.

  • Fixed multistep form frontend step navigation issue
  • Fixed Join Community link URL
  • Fixed plugin checker compatibility issues

  • 360° virtual tour link now opens inside an iframe overlay instead of a plain link
  • Add multistep form free options with stepwise design

  • Replaced deprecated get_page_by_title() with get_posts()

  • Fixed image handling on template reimport
  • Fixed duplicate nav menus created during WXR import
  • Fixed GeoDirectory CPT posts cleanup on full reset import
  • Added link to GeoBuddy Bundle Membership page in templates description

1.0.4

  • Improved compatibility with latest WordPress version
  • Minor performance improvements

1.0.3

  • Enhanced social media field validation
